trustModel.trustBaseId: genesis-entry-id: SHA256(sigBytes of the genesis RootTrustBaseV2, tag 39000)
trustModel.sealRule: native-B1: every signature a valid member signature, 64 bytes or 65 with suffix 0/1, at most 16
trustModel.verification: sdk-4.0.0-utb: TS verifyCertificate / token verifier, Rust verify_certificate_of_partition / verify_token_with_policy
trustModel.missingEpoch: NoEntryForEpoch, unavailable family: retryable once the history holds the epoch
trustModel.evolution: wallet-owned history, SDK fetch-and-retry; the plug-ins fetch nothing

limitsNote: The one resource policy shared by contract, oracle and plug-ins (owner section 36, bft-core briefs/b7-direct-uncapped-design.md section 1): no gas ceiling and no history cap. The composition (BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1) is bounded by envelopeBytes (the ingress bound), the u16 anchor wire width (aggregatorAnchors) and its gas, and streams the history and the anchor table (bft-core briefs/dev4-b7-native-compose-spec.md section 7); transfers, leaves and semanticBytes are the standalone B2 kernel's own bounds (0x0104, prepareLock); the rest are per-object shape bounds.
